podcast.body: This album, referred to as "Sin-Sail-Few," was the first record released by the Australian band "Diabalanches" in 2000. It was considered extremely important in the music market, widely recognized as one of the best albums of that year, and in many rankings, it is cited as the best electronic music album in history. Its creation involved the unprecedented use of over 3000 fragments or samples from other existing records, a process that no one had ever taken to such an extreme. "Sin-Sail-Few" is still credited as the most complex sampling album ever made.
